angle: 5 mistakes ranked, #1 = not knowing what you lifted last time (EARND's core pain)
caption: #1 is the one almost everyone makes

slides.title: CHANGING YOUR PROGRAMME EVERY WEEK.
slides.body: you never repeat anything long enough to beat it.

slides.title: HALF REPS TO ADD WEIGHT.
slides.body: if your form breaks, you haven't earned the increase.

slides.title: LOTS OF EASY SETS.
slides.body: a few hard working sets, close to failure, do the job.

slides.title: NO REST BETWEEN WORKING SETS.
slides.body: rest 2–3 minutes so the next set is a real one.

slides.title: NOT KNOWING WHAT YOU LIFTED LAST TIME.
slides.body: no target means nothing to beat.

slides.title: EARND SHOWS WHAT YOU LIFTED LAST TIME
slides.body: And today's target, on every set.

slides.title: SAVE THIS. FIX ONE NEXT SESSION.
slides.body: EARND launches soon. Follow for the launch.
